results.title: Dana Okafor - Chief of Staff to the CEO - Northwind Capital | LinkedIn

results.text: Chief of Staff to the CEO at Northwind Capital. Previously Director of Strategy & Operations at Lakebridge Ventures. Partner-track operator focused on portfolio operations, LP reporting cadence, and firm-wide planning. San Francisco Bay Area.

Previously Director of Strategy & Operations at Lakebridge Ventures.

results.title: Marcus Lindqvist — Chief of Staff | Riverstone Partners
results.text: Marcus Lindqvist is Chief of Staff at Riverstone Partners, where he supports the Managing Partner across investment operations, fundraising, and platform. Before Riverstone, Marcus spent five years at Halden Growth in a business operations role.
highlights: Marcus Lindqvist is Chief of Staff at Riverstone Partners, supporting the Managing Partner across investment operations and fundraising.
results.summary: Chief of Staff at Riverstone Partners supporting the Managing Partner; prior business operations at Halden Growth.
